verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API whose endpoints carry a version prefix (e.g. GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results), so the API is versioned. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, a version lifecycle or migration guidance, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit API versioning/lifecycle docs, changelog or sunset timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
Get results for an experiment (`GET /v1/experiments/{id}/results`) to pull the latest analysis into your own reporting.
